lesson.title: ਪੰਜ ਸਵਾਲ: The Five Key Questions
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: Yesterday's opening sentence needs real substance. Today: the five ਸਵਾਲ (questions) that give it exactly that.

A strong news opening usually answers as many of these five ਸਵਾਲ as possible: ਕੌਣ (who), ਕੀ (what), ਕਦੋਂ (when), ਕਿੱਥੇ (where), and ਕਿਉਂ (why) — the ਕਾਰਨ (reason) something happened. Not every opening sentence fits all five in cleanly, but a strong one answers at least ਕੌਣ, ਕੀ, and either ਕਦੋਂ or ਕਿੱਥੇ. Take your Day 2 opening sentence and check it against all five questions — which ones does it already answer, and which are missing? Revise your sentence to answer at least one more.
You now have a genuine checklist for making a news opening substantive, not just short. Tomorrow you'll write a complete original news report using everything from this week.

objectives: Identify the five key questions (ਕੌਣ/ਕੀ/ਕਦੋਂ/ਕਿੱਥੇ/ਕਿਉਂ) a strong news opening answers
Revise an opening sentence to answer more of the five questions
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's inverted-pyramid opening sentence.
2. Introduce the five ਸਵਾਲ.
3. Check the Day 2 sentence against all five together.
4. Have the child revise their own sentence to answer at least one more question.
5. Complete the worksheet.
6. Preview tomorrow's topic: writing a complete news report.
differentiationTips: Struggling: work through the five questions one at a time as a checklist, ticking off each as it's addressed rather than revising the whole sentence at once
Ready for more: ask them to identify which of the five questions is hardest to answer in one sentence, and why
Every Gurmukhi word used in this lesson was checked against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. The five key questions are ਕੌਣ (who), ਕੀ (what), ਕਦੋਂ (when), ਕਿੱਥੇ (where), ਕਿਉਂ (why). 2. A strong opening sentence answers at least ਕੌਣ, ਕੀ, and either ਕਦੋਂ or ਕਿੱਥੇ.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'advanced composition and an introduction to Punjabi-language media and journalism' description, giving a concrete, checkable standard for a strong news opening.
